text:
Today I went to the dentist for a checkup to fix one row of my lower teeth and one row of my upper teeth. I had free time today.

Even though I'm 54 years old, I maintain good dental and gum health.
So I got an orthodontic checkup.
I came in the same day and had one tooth extracted, which was a crowded tooth, and I got braces. The dentist and staff were very kind and worked quickly.

I had my teeth scaled and polished elsewhere and they told me to get a root planing, which cost 8,000 baht. The dentist here didn't recommend it.
I'm told to get my teeth scaled and polished every six months.

I highly recommend this place. The shop has a clean, safe, and professional room, but the quality meets standards.
I'm honest and sincere with all customers. I came to review the shop and received a gift set: one toothbrush, two tubes of toothpaste, and a cloth bag.
